notes: «أن معاوية بن صالح، حدثه وحدثني أزهر بن سعيد» is read as one route, Muawiya then Azhar (Azhar is the one Muawiya got it from), since the text gives one saying and one line of names after Muawiya.
The gloss «- يقال له الحرازي شامي عزيز الحديث -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
«قال سألت عائشة» makes Asim the asker before Aisha (rule 5).
